description: Signal counts by kind in a short time window
sql:
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS records
      FROM signal_records
      WHERE timestamp >= :since_ms
        AND timestamp < :until_ms
      GROUP BY kind
      ORDER BY records DESC
limitations: Do not combine local and runtime results
Do not assume paper/live mode from table names
execution_plan: SEARCH signal_records USING INDEX signal_records_timestamp (timestamp>? AND timestamp<?)
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR GROUP BY
USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
